validated_results.title: A prospective study of one-carbon metabolism biomarkers and risk of renal cell carcinoma.
validated_results.reason: This prospective nested case-control study evaluates the association between serum riboflavin (vitamin B2) concentrations and incident renal cell carcinoma risk in male smokers.

extraction.population: Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta-Carotene Cancer Prevention Study cohort of male smokers

sample_size.excerpt: Thus the analysis included 224 RCC cases and 224 matched controls.
sample_size.location: Materials and Methods, Selection of cases and controls, paragraph 1; total_n derived from reported group counts 224 + 224 = 448

cases.excerpt: Prediagnostic folate, vitamin B 6 , vitamin B 12 , cysteine, riboflavin and homocysteine concentrations were measured in fasting serum from 224 incident RCC cases and 224 controls (matched on age and date of serum collection).
cases.location: Materials and Methods, Selection of cases and controls, paragraph 1

effect_size.excerpt: When the cutoff for serum folate was moved by 10% from 6.6 nmol/L down to 5.9 nmol/L or up to 7.3 nmol/L, the odds ratios were 1.66 (0.98-2.80) and 1.16 (0.76-1.78), respectively. Cut-points above 6.8 nmol/L consistently yielded lower odds ratios, suggesting that the increased risk applies only to the lowest concentrations of serum folate.

design.excerpt: We conducted a nested case-control study within the Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta-Carotene Cancer Prevention Study, a prospective study of Finnish male smokers aged 50-69 at baseline.

timing.excerpt: All men enrolled in the study provided fasting serum samples at a baseline visit, prior to randomization, and these samples were stored at -70°C for future analyses.
timing.location: Materials and Methods, Biomarker measurements and questionnaire data, paragraph 1

continent.excerpt: We conducted a nested case-control study within the Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta-Carotene (ATBC) Cancer Prevention Study, which was conducted in Finland as a joint project between the U.S. National Cancer Institute and the National Public Health Institute of Finland.
continent.location: Materials and Methods, Study population, paragraph 1

ethnicity.excerpt: The study population included 29,133 male smokers (at least five cigarettes per day) from southwestern Finland between the ages of 50 and 69 years.
ethnicity.location: Materials and Methods, Study population, paragraph 1
